mapIdentity.scope: The named church way provides the northwest front and full 12-point envelope of the church and attached rear wings. The curved nave, towers and stair and balcony profiles follow written accounts. A separate native way identifies the cemetery.

note: Standing form from IPHAN conservation descriptions, the author of the local historical inventory, the named church footprint and the original terrain. Perimeter detail and vertical dimensions are interpreted. The map height of 30 m is an approximate tower-height control.
